Registration will open **January 2027**, about eight months before the Summit. This page will then list the registration link and the General Terms and Conditions. Package prices below are final.

The 2nd Peritoneal Summit is kept deliberately intimate — **around 90 participants** — to encourage genuine exchange across disciplines.

## Key dates

| Date | Milestone |
|---|---|
| **January 2027** | Registration opens |
| **15 June 2027** | Abstract submission deadline · early-bird registration closes |
| **Early July 2027** | Abstract decisions communicated |
| **Mid-August 2027** | Accommodation booking deadline — limited rooms at the venue, book early |
| **Until the conference** | Regular registration remains open, subject to capacity |

### Accommodation
<p class="price-tbd">Booked directly with the hotel</p>
Per night · at the conference venue
- Conference rate, breakfast included
- Rate code sent with your registration confirmation
- Walking distance from sessions
- Limited availability — book early once registration opens

All prices in CHF, including VAT. The early-bird rate applies until **15 June 2027**; the regular rate applies from 16 June 2027 until the Summit, subject to capacity. Accommodation is not included in the conference packages and is booked directly with Hotel Seaside — the conference rate code comes with your registration confirmation.

## Stay informed

Until registration opens, the best way to stay informed about deadlines and the program is to keep an eye on this page or contact the organizers (see [Contact](contact.qmd)).

## General Terms and Conditions

The full GTCs will be published alongside registration in January 2027.
